steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap in loose cloud shapes
steps.rule: color underneath gets picked up so a touch is enough

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: dry blend base of the sky
steps.where: base of the sky, top left alone

steps.subject: other: small shapes
steps.action: lay in basic shapes near the horizon

steps.subject: other: small shapes
steps.action: blend shapes with the large brush
steps.rule: blending picks up the base color so it darkens

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: fill the tape gap with dark color

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: lightly touch in distant tree shapes
steps.load: a touch of each mixed on the brush
steps.rule: far things stay light and soft

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: dab in closer evergreen shapes
steps.where: in front of the far trees

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: paint a rock point out into the water
steps.rule: brush strokes alone can suggest rock and stone

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: add a touch of white so the strokes show
steps.rule: added so the strokes show, not normal practice

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: dab small white waves at the horizon
steps.where: back at the horizon, dark gaps left

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: lay in the major wave line
steps.where: across the middle of the wave line

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: wipe brush nearly dry and pull paint back
steps.rule: pulling paint back creates the trough on its own

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: cut off the end of the rocky point

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub bright eye of the wave
steps.load: mostly white with the least touch of yellow

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: reload and repeat the eye, light to dark outward
steps.load: full load from a clean brush
steps.motion: work outward from the light into darker
steps.where: eye of the wave, then outward
steps.rule: a clean brush keeps the transparency fresh

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: feather the wave blend with a light touch
steps.rule: a very light touch keeps the blend smooth

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: plain white crash splashing and churning
steps.where: top of the wave, crashing over
steps.rule: plain white picks up the color underneath when blended

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub shadow foam with tiny circles
steps.load: white loaded with the blue and crimson mix, full
steps.rule: shadow goes in first, highlights after

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: push upward highlights on the foam edge
steps.motion: small sideways upward pushes, wiping the brush
steps.where: top of the shadow foam at the edge
steps.rule: a damp brush would thin the paint so it must be dry

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend foam with a clean dry corner of a 2in
steps.motion: stir lightly with the top corner

steps.subject: other: spray
steps.action: dab fine spray droplets just outside the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: run dark line around the wave edge
steps.load: a little dark thinned with paint thinner
steps.rule: separates the two areas so the wave stands up

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend the dark line out until it fades

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: lay in foam shapes on the turning wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add small sparkle details with thinned white and blue
steps.load: thinned with paint thinner, a least touch of blue
steps.rule: details make the painting stand out

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add the brightest highlights
steps.load: pure white with a touch of yellow

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add small detail strokes along the wave lines
steps.motion: small strokes following the wave shapes

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: add a small dark stone in the front with the small knife
steps.load: dark with a touch of white
steps.motion: bump the knife edge down, barely touching
steps.rule: keeps it dark so it does not distract

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: soften stone edges with water on a liner
steps.motion: gentle strokes up around the edges
steps.where: around the edges of the stone
steps.rule: helps the stone fit into the scene
